description: Paperback Chic is a simplified design style prevalent between the late 2010s and present that features natural, soft colors, playful or retro airy layouts and display fonts that gives modern product labeling/packaging and branding a friendly, wholesome, and artistic paperback-book look where they appear everywhere from trendy food package labels to wellness drinks. It is often used by cafes and organic food brands to appeal to a general market.
